name: goli-cli
description: Enterprise-grade, open-weight-first AI coding agent. Exposes a curated subset of Goli-CLI's built-in tools (read_file, edit_file, grep, glob, list_directory, web_search, web_fetch, todo_write, spawn_subagent) to any MCP-compatible client.
long_description: Goli-CLI is a terminal-based AI coding agent that emphasizes reproducibility, security, and open-weight model choice. This MCP server manifest exposes a read-mostly subset of Goli-CLI's tools to any MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, etc.). The full tool set (bash, write_file, notebook_edit, lsp_*) is not exposed by default because they require the sandbox; install the Goli-CLI binary directly to use them.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. The path must be inside the workspace root.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

offset.description: Optional 1-indexed line number to start reading from.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of lines to read.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a file by replacing old_str with new_str. The old_str must be unique in the file. Produces a unified diff for review before applying.

old_str.description: The exact text to replace. Must be unique in the file.

new_str.description: The text to replace it with. Use empty string to delete.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents using ripgrep 14. Supports the full ripgrep regex syntax.

path.description: Directory to search in. Default: workspace root.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files by glob pattern. Uses the workspace root as the base.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the contents of a directory.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web via the configured search provider (default: DuckDuckGo).

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return the content as Markdown (readability-extracted).

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Write or update the agent's todo list. The list is shown in the TUI and is used to track progress on multi-step tasks.

tools.name: spawn_subagent
tools.description: Spawn a subagent with its own context window and tool registry. Returns the subagent's summary (not the full transcript).

task.description: A self-contained description of the subtask.

tools.description: Optional list of tool names the subagent can use. Default: all tools.

model.description: Optional model override for the subagent.

prompts.name: explain-codebase
prompts.description: Produce a high-level architectural overview of the codebase in the workspace.

arguments.name: focus
arguments.description: Optional area to focus on (e.g. 'agent loop', 'sandbox', 'memory').

prompts.name: find-bugs
prompts.description: Identify likely bugs in a specific file or directory.

prompts.name: write-tests
prompts.description: Generate unit tests for a specific file, following the project's testing conventions.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Source file to generate tests for.

prompts.name: refactor
prompts.description: Propose a refactor of a specific file, explaining the motivation and the steps.

resources.name: AGENTS.md
resources.description: The living-patterns & gotchas doc for the current workspace.

resources.name: default config
resources.description: The default TOML configuration for Goli-CLI.

resources.name: session list
resources.description: A JSON list of all stored sessions.

security.network_egress: default deny; allowlist for web_search and web_fetch
